events.name: codesense:agents-changed
events.timing: On agent state / roster change
events.description: Nudge for `onAgentsChanged` / `onSessions` listeners.

events.name: codesense:badge
events.timing: On `codesense.setBadge()` call
events.description: Update the chrome badge for this tab.

events.name: codesense:before-reload
events.timing: When a shown pane freezes for a source save or Reload
events.description: Ask the registered onBeforeReload hook for JSON, bounded to 64 KB and 100 ms. Internal transport; snapshot capture never gates the swap.

events.name: codesense:before-reload-result
events.timing: After optional capture, or immediately when no hook is registered
events.description: Return JSON or null for this frame instance and request. Oversize, late and invalid results are dropped and logged in the frame and host.

events.name: codesense:child-focus
events.timing: After a hosted child's menu closes
events.description: Architecture: focus the nested iframe in its parent before returning focus to the child's anchor.

events.name: codesense:child-rect
events.timing: Before a hosted child's menu opens
events.description: Architecture: ask the parent dashboard to measure the matching child iframe across the origin boundary.

events.name: codesense:child-rect-result
events.timing: In response to child-rect
events.description: Architecture: the parent's child iframe rectangle in parent-frame coordinates; absent when the child is gone.

events.name: codesense:close-tab
events.timing: On Cmd+W (⌘W, Ctrl+W)
events.description: Forward the close-tab chord — the parent closes this centre tab.

events.name: codesense:command
events.timing: After the page's ready(), once per dispatchId, when a chord or the palette runs one of its commands
events.description: Deliver a declared command to a slot dashboard. The host reveals the slot first and queues the command until the page is ready; one still queued when the pane fails to load is dropped with a toast.

events.name: codesense:content-size
events.timing: On DOM resize (ResizeObserver)
events.description: Inline message height — the parent sizes the frame to this.

events.name: codesense:context-changed
events.timing: On context index change
events.description: Nudge for `subscribeContext` listeners — the context metadata index changed; re-query.

events.name: codesense:contextmenu
events.payload: {target: row|text|frame, row?, text?, textId, anchorRect, anchorId?}
events.timing: After a context-click and its one-tick page-owned menu window
events.description: Architecture: fields and selected text get the shared text menu; story, epic, file, agent, workspace, group, conversation, message, attachment and role-queue tags use their native builders. Unknown rows and empty space get the dashboard menu. A page may handle the click or call showMenu within one tick. The browser menu is always suppressed.
events.example: // Add data-codesense-row to an agent row; no event listener is needed.

events.name: codesense:delta
events.payload: { topic, viewKey, rev, upserts: rows[], removes: ids[], requestId? }
events.timing: After a subscribed view changes, at most once per 50 ms
events.description: Apply stable-id row changes to the subscribed view. A revision gap resyncs the snapshot.

events.name: codesense:doc-error
events.timing: On `window.onerror` / `unhandledrejection`
events.description: Report a script failure — a pane host shows it in place.

events.name: codesense:external-link
events.timing: On click of http(s) / mailto link
events.description: Open the URL in the OS handler (never inside the iframe).

events.name: codesense:flush
events.timing: Before replacement reads or retirement (300 ms), or quit (one shared 500 ms deadline)
events.description: Run every onFlush callback and wait for its promise before acknowledging. A pre-reload flush keeps the shown document alive. Retirement tears it down at the deadline even when a callback never settles.

events.name: codesense:flush-ack
events.timing: When all registered flush callbacks settle
events.description: The shim acknowledges the matching host flush automatically, including when a callback rejects or none is registered.

events.name: codesense:focus-in
events.timing: When focus enters a frame
events.description: Focus the first available control unless an onFocusIn handler owns focus.

events.name: codesense:focus-return
events.timing: After a host menu, popover or confirmation closes
events.description: Focus the opening anchor, or the first available control if it has gone. An onFocusReturn handler receives {anchorId} and replaces default focus.

events.name: codesense:focus-suppressed
events.timing: When an off-screen candidate attempts to focus a control
events.description: Remember and blur candidate autofocus, then ask the host to restore the previous focus owner. The shim replays it only when presented with permission.
events.example: // Internal presentation transport; no page handler is required.

events.name: codesense:frame-focus
events.timing: When the child window gains focus
events.description: Internal focus notification: the host records frame ownership and delivers focus-in for ordinary entry. A return from host UI preserves the focus-return anchor.

events.name: codesense:freeze
events.timing: At pane-save freeze and on recovery from a failed attempt
events.description: Block pointer and keyboard input through the shim while retaining the active control. The working frame stays shown; a failed replacement unfreezes it.
events.example: // Managed by the host and shim.

events.name: codesense:hello
events.timing: When a tab is shown before the page's ready was received
events.description: Asks a page that has not yet been answered to post codesense:ready again. A page the host has already answered ignores it, and the host ignores a repeated ready for a handshake already done.

events.name: codesense:inbox-changed
events.timing: On inbox update
events.description: Nudge for `watchInbox` / `onInboxChanged` listeners.

events.name: codesense:intent
events.payload: { intent: Record<string, JSON> } (at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes)
events.timing: Immediately when ready, or after codesense:ready for a new or reloaded document
events.description: Deliver the latest pending pane_open intent. One pending intent per panel; newer replaces older. The host clears delivered intents so later reloads do not replay them. The shim buffers the last undelivered intent for a late onIntent subscriber and consumes it once. The page interprets the object.

events.name: codesense:invoke
events.timing: On codesense.invoke() call
events.description: The bridge RPC request. You never emit this directly — call `codesense.invoke(cmd, args)` and the shim posts it for you.

events.name: codesense:invoke-result
events.timing: Response to `codesense:invoke`
events.description: Correlated reply carrying the invoke result or a structured error.
events.example: // Correlated reply — resolves the shim's invoke() Promise.

events.name: codesense:key-escape
events.timing: After an unhandled, unmodified Esc outside IME composition
events.description: Run a command bound to Esc, else exit an overlay, or focus the terminal from a docked right-pane, dock or file-nav slot. Centre-frame Esc has no other host action.
events.example: // Call preventDefault() to keep Esc in the page.

events.name: codesense:live
events.timing: When the page calls codesense.ready()
events.description: The page has finished starting. A slot uses this explicit signal, or its first admitted subscribe, to stop its fallback deadline. The automatic codesense:ready event is only a transport handshake.

events.name: codesense:machines-changed
events.timing: On machine list change
events.description: Nudge for `machines()` listeners.

events.name: codesense:menu-action
events.timing: After a host menu activation (before the persisted write for mark-unread)
events.description: Architecture: deliver page-local menu actions to onMenuAction. Hosted message actions reach the inbox parent, preserving its navigation and unread hold.

events.name: codesense:menu-action-ack
events.timing: After synchronous page menu callbacks finish
events.description: Architecture: confirm that Mark as unread established its page hold before the host persists the unread state.
events.example: // Applied by the shim, not page code.

events.name: codesense:menu-actions
events.timing: When onMenuAction listeners register or unsubscribe
events.description: Architecture: advertise page action availability so host menus omit Open, Reply and Open queue when no page handler exists.
events.example: codesense.onMenuAction(({itemId, row}) => { /* navigate in the page */ });

events.name: codesense:navigate
events.timing: On click of `.md` / `.html` / `.htm` link
events.description: Intercepted link click — the host routes to the file (same tab, new tab with Meta).
events.example:
// Emitted automatically by the LINK_INTERCEPTOR_JS.
// No doc-side action needed.

events.name: codesense:paste-target-changed
events.timing: When the person's active terminal appears, goes or the workspace changes
events.description: Nudge for `canPasteToTerminal()` listeners.

events.name: codesense:ping
events.timing: Every 5 seconds while visible
events.description: The shim answers automatically. Three consecutive missed answers use the existing crashed fallback strip.

events.name: codesense:pong
events.timing: Immediately after a ping
events.description: The heartbeat answer resets the host missed-pong count. Hidden frames are not pinged.

events.name: codesense:presentation
events.timing: At the frame handshake and the atomic replacement swap
events.description: Gate candidate focus until shown. Replay pending autofocus only while the slot owns focus; never steal it from another app control.

events.name: codesense:ready
events.timing: After shim IIFE runs
events.description: Announce doc loaded; the host answers with slot-context, theme, visibility and pending intent, in that order.

events.name: codesense:rebind
events.timing: After a team switch re-mints the dock frame's grant
events.description: The shim adopts the new token, replays the held calls with it, and the host then sends the new team in slot context and resyncs every subscribed topic. The old token is already refused.

events.name: codesense:rebind-ack
events.timing: On codesense:rebind-pending
events.description: Every call sent before the pause has been posted; the host may now re-mint.

events.name: codesense:rebind-pending
events.timing: Before a dock frame moves to a new team
events.description: The shim holds new SDK calls until the matching codesense:rebind and acknowledges with codesense:rebind-ack, so calls sent before it reach the host first.
events.example: // Handled by the shim; calls made meanwhile are queued and replayed.

events.name: codesense:reload-state
events.timing: At the handshake, once optional capture settles
events.description: Resolve reloadState exactly once to the previous document snapshot or null. Missing state resolves promptly without waiting for the capture deadline.

events.name: codesense:reload-warning
events.timing: When an optional beforeReload snapshot is dropped
events.description: Write one console.warn for the capture request. The host also logs the document identity and reason; the replacement continues.
events.example: // Use the warning to fix an oversized or slow onBeforeReload hook.

events.name: codesense:restore-focus
events.timing: When candidate focus is suppressed or a failed reload returns to the working pane
events.description: Restore the control remembered by the old shim at freeze, with preventScroll. The shown embedding stays focusable while its input remains blocked.
events.example: // Internal presentation transport; no page handler is required.

events.name: codesense:restore-scroll
events.timing: After iframe load
events.description: Restore the saved scroll offset from the last visit.
events.example:
// Handled automatically by the shim.
// Pair with codesense:scroll (doc → parent) to persist offsets.

events.name: codesense:resync
events.timing: When a frame exceeds its pending delta budget
events.description: Discard pending changes and subscribe again from the last revision.

events.name: codesense:routines-changed
events.timing: On routine list change
events.description: Nudge for routine-aware dashboards — call `codesense.routines()` or `codesense.routineResult(args)` to re-read.

events.name: codesense:scroll
events.timing: On scroll (throttled rAF)
events.description: Save the current scroll position so the parent can restore it across an iframe reload.

events.name: codesense:shortcut
events.payload: { key, code, metaKey, ctrlKey, shiftKey, altKey, editorTarget, textFieldTarget }
events.timing: On an unhandled Command, Control or Option chord, or a function key (excluding composition)
events.description: Forward a key description for the host shortcut registry (built-ins and slot dashboards' commands) and user bindings; editorTarget and textFieldTarget preserve editor-owned navigation and split keys; generic chords retain browser defaults.

events.name: codesense:slot-context
events.payload: {context: {slotId, presentation, width, narrow, team, focusedSession?, currentFile?, selection?, theme}}
events.timing: Before theme on ready, and whenever slot context changes
events.description: The host context includes nav selection; onNavSelectionChange is an alias over this selection. Narrow is true below 300 pixels.

events.name: codesense:snapshot
events.timing: On `codesense.snapshot(state)` call
events.description: Archive HTML + optional state sidecar.

events.name: codesense:snapshot-request
events.timing: On snapshot button / doc capture
events.description: Host asks the doc to serialize its DOM (or innerText). The shim replies with `codesense:snapshot-result`.

events.name: codesense:snapshot-result
events.payload: { id, ok, html?, content?, capturedAt?, truncated?, error? }
events.timing: Response to `codesense:snapshot-request` / `codesense:snapshot`
events.description: Correlated reply carrying the frozen DOM or an error.
events.example: // Correlated reply — handled inside the shim.

events.name: codesense:stale
events.timing: Once when a hidden frame falls behind
events.description: Mark the hidden view stale without fetching; becoming visible resyncs it.

events.name: codesense:teardown
events.timing: After flush acknowledgment or deadline
events.description: The host retires the frame. onTeardown callbacks release page-owned resources; saving belongs in onFlush.

events.name: codesense:text-edit
events.timing: After the person activates a text-menu item
events.description: Architecture: restore the exact clicked field and selection, then apply cut, copy, paste or selectAll through its input path. Only the host's Paste activation reads and sends clipboard text.
events.example: // Applied by the shim; pages do not send paste requests.

events.name: codesense:text-menu-closed
events.timing: After the automatic text menu settles, including dismissal or failure
events.description: Architecture: clear the matching shim-owned textMenuOpen state. A superseded menu cannot clear a newer text menu's state.

events.name: codesense:theme
events.timing: After doc ready, on theme change
events.description: Apply the token palette and optionally the CSS `color-scheme`. Fires on initial render and whenever the viewer theme switches.

events.name: codesense:theme-applied
events.timing: One animation frame after the shim applies a codesense:theme
events.description: Posted automatically. The host keeps the frame transparent until it arrives, so the page never shows unthemed; a frame that never acks is revealed after a short fallback.

events.name: codesense:visibility
events.timing: After doc ready, on visibility change
events.description: Tell the doc whether it's currently on-screen (useful for render hints or pausing animations).

events.name: codesense:worktrees-changed
events.timing: On managed worktree change
events.description: Nudge for `worktrees()` listeners.
